description: F2 — the flagship multi-conversation memory fixture. Session 1 is a fully-specified consult that plants distinctive proper nouns (Menashe / Silverstein Lighting) and writes a memory row. Session 2 (new_session) references the situation obliquely, omitting the name and company; the advisor must resurface the planted tokens from MEMORY (they are far outside the corpus vocabulary, so a hit cannot be hallucinated from the book). Service-level advisor case: no media is injected.
